:::{#def-tuple}
#### Tuple

For a [natural number](number-systems.qmd#def-natural-numbers) $n$,
an **$n$-tuple**
[@wikipedia_tuple]
$(a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n)$
is a list of $n$ objects in order.
Two $n$-tuples are equal <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
when their entries are equal in each position.

:::
